text: Be of good courage: Heb. be strong
goldsmith: Or, founder | him that smote: Or, the smiting | saying: , It is ready for the sodering: Or, saying of the soder, it is good
they that strive with thee: Heb. the men of thy strife
them that contended: Heb. the men of thy contention | they that war against thee: Heb. the men of thy war
Produce: Heb. cause to come near
consider them, and know: Heb. set our heart upon them
of nothing: Or, worse than nothing | of naught: Or, worse then of a viper
